meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读入 Newick、NHX、PhyloXML 等树文件,做剪枝、重定根、Robinson-Foulds 比较、基因树演化事件检测和 NCBI 分类注释,并渲染出 PDF/SVG/PNG 树图。
howto.when: 当你提供一棵系统发育树文件,或要求做树的剪枝与重定根、Robinson-Foulds 比较、NCBI 分类注释、树图渲染时触发。它不负责从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 把这棵 tree.nw 从 midpoint 重新定根,再剪到这三个物种
say.note: 输出重定根并剪枝后的新树文件

howto.what_en: Claude reads tree files (Newick/NHX/PhyloXML/NeXML) and can prune, reroot, run Robinson-Foulds comparisons, detect gene-tree duplication/speciation events, annotate with NCBI taxonomy, and render PDF/SVG/PNG figures.
howto.when_en: Use it when you supply a phylogenetic tree file, or ask for pruning/rerooting, Robinson-Foulds comparison, NCBI taxonomy annotation, or figure rendering. It does not infer trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Reroot tree.nw at the midpoint, then prune it to these three species
say_en.note: Produces a rerooted, pruned tree file

say_en.text: Compute the Robinson-Foulds distance between tree1.nw and tree2.nw
say_en.note: Returns RF distance, normalized value, shared leaves

say_en.text: Annotate this tree's leaves with NCBI taxid and lineage, then export a PDF
say_en.note: First run downloads the ~300MB taxonomy DB
